_comment: docs/09 §9.3 synergy sets and §9.4 evolution paths.
A set fires when the run holds 'threshold' DISTINCT members — copies do not
count. Three copies of Long Weave is one Weaver member, not three, or every
set would fire off a single stacked Common.
Sets are discovered, not listed (§9.3). The collection screen fills a set's
name and members in as the player meets them, so nothing here is shown up
Evolutions replace their base card rather than adding to it. 'requires' is
read as: every listed id at the listed number of copies.
